prompt:
Reach the blue target at column 11, row 1. Before every action, check your current column and row and apply these rules:
- If you are at (11,1), choose STOP and keep choosing STOP.
- If your column is less than 7: choose UP while your row is greater than 1; once your row is 1, choose RIGHT.
- If your column is 7 through 10: choose DOWN while your row is less than 7; once your row is 7, choose RIGHT.
- If your column is 11 and your row is greater than 1, choose UP.
Check that the next cell is free. Reevaluate these rules after every step. Reply with exactly one action: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, or STOP.
